requests.requestPackage: Independent application and release security review bound to the qualified candidate, with findings, disposition, reviewer identity/reference, verification time and validity period.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: Must satisfy the governed C30 supplied-and-verified contract and artifact SHA-256 integrity; engineering self-attestation is not acceptable.

requests.requestPackage: Independent privacy and PDPL review of data flows, retention, lawful basis, access boundaries and release posture, bound to the qualified candidate.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: Must be an independently issued privacy disposition with governed metadata and artifact hash; generated privacy text is not approval.

requests.ownerRole: AI governance owner / authorized provider administrator
requests.requestPackage: Documented authorization for the intended production AI provider/configuration, including account/tenant scope, data-use constraints and approved production boundary.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: Must originate from the accountable provider/governance owner and remain separate from application engineering qualification.

requests.requestPackage: Evidence of lawful rights to use each governed external source in the intended production and reporting context, including restrictions and provenance references.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: Rights must be independently verifiable; source availability or technical access alone does not establish legal usage rights.

requests.ownerRole: Business product owner / designated UAT panel
requests.requestPackage: Executed human UAT on the qualified candidate using approved scenarios, defects/dispositions, participant identity/reference and explicit acceptance or rejection.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: Browser E2E, CI and synthetic test fixtures are engineering evidence only and cannot substitute for human UAT approval.

requests.ownerRole: Independent model validation / valuation QA owner
requests.requestPackage: Executed historical replay against approved real historical cases/data with expected-versus-actual results, exceptions, methodology/version binding and reviewer disposition.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: Synthetic cases do not satisfy historical replay; the evidence must be generated from real approved historical inputs and independently reviewed.

requests.requestPackage: Executed rollback rehearsal or operational verification for the applicable release path, including exact rollback identity, timing, recovery evidence and operator sign-off.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: A written rollback plan alone is insufficient; operational verification must be executed and independently recorded.

requests.requestPackage: Independent legal/regulatory review covering the intended Saudi real-estate decision-support use, disclosures, professional-boundary risks and release constraints.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: Must be a real accountable legal/regulatory disposition; engineering or AI-generated legal analysis cannot serve as approval.

requests.requestPackage: Real composite-baseline candidate and matching evidence artifacts for governed shadow evaluation against the current registry.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: Both governed inputs must be supplied together and pass the existing shadow gate as VERIFIED without activation.

requests.requestPackage: Real fresh-cycle composite candidate and evidence artifacts with cycle identity and evidence hashes for the existing fresh-shadow evaluator.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: The governed gate must return VERIFIED; test fixtures and stale cycles are not acceptable real inputs.

requests.requestPackage: Real successor fresh composite candidate and evidence artifacts bound to current registry content identity and the applicable successor cycle.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: Must satisfy the successor fresh-shadow governed evaluator as VERIFIED without any automatic reactivation or cutover.

requests.requestPackage: Reviewer lifecycle, activation plan, verified shadow evaluation and executed rehearsal result for the governed cutover-safety gate.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: All four real artifacts are required together; VERIFIED means safety prerequisites satisfied but activation remains separately prohibited.

requests.ownerRole: Canonical source custodian / data governance owner
requests.requestPackage: The actual external canonical source file whose real bytes are expected to match SHA-256 ac0767d3f13c463259f401a5d7af06c1140ee780a9f86489eb17ad9d7c72dc71.
requests.acceptanceBoundary: The verifier must compute the digest from the actual supplied source bytes; a copied hash value or generated substitute is not evidence.
